text:
Palladium Price in 2023
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2023, the LBMA palladium price fell 29.8% between 2023-01-31 ($1,618) and 2023-12-28 ($1,136). The highest sampled price was $1,618 in January and the lowest was $1,025 in November. The mean of these observations was $1,312. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
